app.title: Map editor
models.title: Model import
models.intro: Models loaded: {n}. Each one was converted to .glb.
models.missing: {file}: missing files: {names}. Select them together with the model (pick several files at once or pack everything into a .zip).
models.unused: {file}: skipped – not a model or a companion file.
models.noModel: None of the selected files is a model (.glb, .gltf, .fbx, .obj).
models.none: No models have been loaded yet.
tb.moveHint: Select and move objects with the gizmo arrows
tb.sculptHint: Terrain brushes: raise, lower, smooth, flatten, noise
tb.gameViewHint: Camera set up like in the game; hides editor-only objects
palette.intro: Click a type, then the terrain to place an object. Paths and zones are drawn point by point.
terrain.targetHint: The Flatten brush moves terrain towards this height. Ctrl + click on terrain picks the height.
terrain.sculptHelp: Hold the left button and paint. Shift swaps raise and lower. Ctrl + click picks the flatten height.
terrain.baseLayer: The first layer is the base – painting with it works like an eraser
terrain.paintHelp: Pick a layer and paint. Shift + paint restores the base. Water ripples in the preview.
terrain.waterLevelHint: Height of the water surface in hollows; on higher ground water lies just above the terrain
terrain.slopeEnable: Mark slopes that are too steep as impassable
terrain.slopeHelp: Slopes steeper than the limit go into the impassable mask of the saved file. Gentler slopes can be climbed at normal speed.
list.selectGroupHint: Select all objects of the group
list.rowHint: Click to select (Shift – add). Double-click to show the object.
list.empty: The map has no objects yet.
props.nothingSelected: Nothing selected. Click an object in the view or in the list.
props.multiTypes: Objects of different types – only the buttons above apply.
props.name: Name
props.pointsHelp: Drag the white dots, double-click next to the line to add a point, Alt + click or Delete removes a point.
validation.ok: All good – the map follows the schema rules.
validation.clickHint: Click to go to the object
issue.unknownType: “{name}”: type “{type}” is not in the schema
issue.refWrongType: “{name}”: “{prop}” points to “{target}” of the wrong type ({type})
issue.pathTooShort: “{name}”: a path needs at least 2 points
issue.zoneTooShort: “{name}”: a zone needs at least 3 points
issue.outsideMap: “{name}”: the object is outside the map
issue.ruleCountMin: Too few objects of type “{type}”: {count}, at least {min} required
issue.ruleCountMax: Too many objects of type “{type}”: {count}, at most {max} allowed (“{name}”)
issue.unknownLayer: Terrain layer “{layer}” is not in the schema
issue.schemaMismatch: The map was made for schema “{map}”, but “{schema}” is loaded
hint.select: Click an object to select it (Shift – add). Drag an object over the terrain or use the gizmo. Drag on empty space for box selection. Right button rotates the view, wheel zooms, middle button pans.
hint.vertex: Drag the point. Delete or Alt + click removes it, double-click next to the line adds a new one.
hint.sculpt.raise: Raise terrain: hold the left button (Shift – lower). [ ] changes size.
hint.sculpt.lower: Lower terrain: hold the left button (Shift – raise). [ ] changes size.
hint.sculpt.smooth: Smooth terrain: hold the left button.
hint.sculpt.flatten: Flatten to the height from the Terrain panel. Ctrl + click picks the height from the terrain.
hint.paint: Painting layer “{layer}”: hold the left button (Shift – restore base).
hint.place: Click the terrain to place “{name}”. Esc stops placing.
hint.placeNone: Pick an object type from the palette.
hint.drawPath: Drawing path “{name}” (points: {n}): click the next points, Enter or double-click finishes, Backspace removes the last point, Esc cancels.
hint.drawZone: Drawing zone “{name}” (points: {n}): click the corners, click the first point, Enter or double-click closes, Backspace removes the last point, Esc cancels.
newMap.title: New map
newMap.name: Map name
newMap.resolutionHint: More points = finer terrain detail, but a bigger file and slower brushes. 129 or 257 is usually enough.
dlg.unsavedText: The map has changes that were not saved to a file. The working copy in the browser will be replaced. Continue?
dlg.schemaMismatch: This map was made for schema “{map}”, but “{schema}” is loaded now. Load the right schema first (File → Load game schema). Open the map anyway?
dlg.schemaLoadedText: The current map now uses the new schema (check the error list). Create a new, empty map?
toast.savedWithErrors: Note: the map has errors ({n}) – saved anyway
status.autosaveFailed: Working copy saving does not work
help.title: Help
help.mouse1: Left button – current tool (select, brush, place).
help.mouse2: Right button – rotate the view; Shift + right – pan.
help.mouse3: Middle button – pan the view; wheel – zoom.
help.mouse4: In game view the angle and distance are fixed, both buttons pan.
help.more: The full guide is in README.md in the repository.
sc.heightTools: Brushes: raise, lower, smooth, flatten, noise
sc.invert: Invert the brush (lower instead of raise, eraser when painting); add to selection
sc.finish: Finish drawing a path or zone
sc.deleteVertex: Delete a path or zone point
minimap.hint: Minimap: click or drag to move the camera
